summary: Verified i18n localization (EN/FR/DE) of Engineer App home (/svc/engineer) and Account Settings drawer + SpeedDial FAB for the 4 files in Batch 1 (EngineerSpeedDial, EngineerHomeV2, EngineerHome, EngineerAccountSettings). All primary strings render correctly in all 3 languages; the previously broken SpeedDial no longer crashes and shows translated actions. Two very minor untranslated strings observed (see minor issues).

design_issues.screen: EngineerHomeV2 - Today's jobs panel header link
issues: The 'View all →' link next to 'Today's jobs' header is HARD-CODED in English in FR and DE (should be 'Voir tout →' and 'Alle anzeigen →'). Interestingly, the same link inside the Pending quotes panel IS translated ('Voir tout →' / 'Alle anzeigen →'), so only the today's-jobs one has the leaked English string. Minor priority.

Footer text 'Pulse Fitness Engineer · v2' shows in DE as 'Pulse Fitness Engineer · v2' — the word 'Engineer' is not localized to 'Techniker'. FR correctly shows 'Pulse Fitness Technicien · v2'. Very low priority (brand-like footer).

verification_details.speeddial_no_crash: engineer-speed-dial-launcher FAB is visible on /svc/engineer in all languages, clicking it opens 3 actions (voice/ask/feedback). No 'useTranslation is not defined' errors in console. ✅
verification_details.console_errors: Only CSP warnings for 3rd-party analytics (emergent-main.js, posthog, cloudflareinsights) and 2 unrelated 404s. No React runtime errors, no i18n errors.

action_items: Minor: Translate the 'View all →' link inside EngineerHomeV2's Today's jobs panel header (currently hard-coded English; the sibling in Pending quotes uses the translated key correctly, so likely a duplicated literal instead of t('...'))
Optional: In DE footer 'Pulse Fitness Engineer · v2', localize 'Engineer' → 'Techniker' (FR already does this: 'Technicien'). Very low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: The i18n changes look clean; keys under service.eng_* namespace exist consistently across en/fr/de (249 keys each). No missing keys triggered fallback to English in observed screens.
Consider a lint rule / grep audit for the literal string 'View all' inside EngineerHomeV2.js to catch other single-panel leftovers.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical i18n coverage passes; 2 tiny leftover strings)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 1 Engineer i18n (EngineerSpeedDial + EngineerHomeV2 + EngineerHome + EngineerAccountSettings) is functionally complete in EN/FR/DE. SpeedDial crash regression is fixed (useTranslation import restored). Only tiny leftover: the 'View all →' link in Today's jobs panel of EngineerHomeV2 is not translated; sibling Pending quotes panel is. Also DE drawer footer 'Engineer' word not localized to 'Techniker'. Both are cosmetic and non-blocking.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs. The two minor leaks look like hard-coded string literals in JSX instead of t() calls (Today's jobs 'View all' link, and the footer 'Engineer' word in the DE locale value).
